question: 4 This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below. (Left) 815 497 460 637 147 (Right) (Example- 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7) (NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.) What will be the resultant if the second digit of the highest number is subtracted from the third digit of the lowest number?
solution:
As per the question,

Given Numbers: 815 497 460 637 147

Rule: Subtract the second digit of the highest number from the third digit of the lowest number.

→ Highest number: 815

→ Second digit of the highest number: 1

→ Lowest number: 147

→ Third digit of the lowest number: 7

Resultant:

(Third digit of lowest) - (Second digit of highest)

7 - 1 = 6

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
